verbs.name: screen_record.copy_raw
verbs.description: Save another byte-for-byte copy of a successfully saved raw recording without editing or remuxing it. Pass the absolute raw_path returned by screen_record.stop. The source must be a plain regular MP4 inside the active project's authorized export-read roots, and the destination receives the normal output fence and lease. The copy runs as a cancellable job using a private sibling stage, then publishes only a complete file. The default name is collision-safe in the selected output folder or project exports. Poll jobs.status for completion; cancellation removes the stage and preserves the source.

source.description: Absolute raw_path from a successful screen_record.stop; must still be a plain MP4 in this project's authorized export-read roots.

path.description: Optional fenced .mp4 Save As destination; omitted uses the selected output folder or project exports with a collision-safe raw_recording-copy.mp4 name.

verbs.result: {job_id,path,status:"queued"}; completed jobs.status result is {path,bytes}. No timeline mutation.
